title: Knowledge-guided Pattern Discovery via Coupled Tensor Factorizations
abstract: arXiv:2608.13234v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In order to understand complex systems such as the human metabolome or human brain, different sensing technologies are used, generating complex data. These datasets are often multiway, i.e., with more than two axes of variation such as a subjects by metabolites by time array. While tensor factorizations have successfully revealed interpretable patterns from such complex data, they have so far been mainly data-driven. On the other hand, there is more to data -- there are computational models (of these systems), which are rich sources of prior information. In this paper, we introduce a knowledge-guided approach that brings together data and computational models by jointly analyzing real data and simulated data (generated using a computational model) using coupled tensor factorizations with linear coupling. Our experiments on real metabolomics measurements demonstrate that guiding the analysis of such noisy data with simulated data improves

translated_title: 基于耦合张量分解的知识引导模式发现
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13234v1 公告类型：新 摘要：为了理解诸如人类代谢组或人脑等复杂系统，使用了不同的传感技术，生成复杂数据。这些数据集通常是多维的，即具有超过两个变化轴，例如受试者乘以代谢物乘以时间的数组。虽然张量分解已成功从这类复杂数据中揭示可解释的模式，但迄今为止它们主要依赖于数据驱动。另一方面，数据之外还有更多内容——存在这些系统的计算模型，这些模型是丰富先验信息的来源。在本文中，我们介绍了一种知识引导方法，通过使用线性耦合的耦合张量分解，联合分析真实数据和模拟数据（使用计算模型生成），将数据和计算模型结合起来。我们在真实代谢组学测量上的实验表明，用模拟数据引导这类噪声数据的分析能改善结果。
tldr: 本文提出一种知识引导的张量分解方法，通过耦合真实数据与模拟数据，利用计算模型先验信息，提升了噪声代谢组学数据分析的模式发现能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a knowledge-guided tensor factorization approach that couples real and simulated data to leverage computational model priors, improving pattern discovery in noisy metabolomics data.
